quests.title: Battery graphite
quests.text: The graphite line floats and rounds graphite schist; the graphite furnace purifies it to 99.95 % carbon at about 2,800 C, a 1.4 MW load under a nitrogen purge.

quests.title: Cathode powder
quests.text: The LFP kiln: iron ingots, lithium carbonate from the lithium plant and phosphoric acid from the fertilizer plant, calcined at 700 C under nitrogen.

quests.title: A battery module
quests.text: The cell line coats, stacks, fills and forms 52 cells into a 52.2 kWh module every 10 minutes. Its electrolyte takes anhydrous HF and ethylene.

quests.title: A battery cabinet
quests.text: Five modules in a 125 kW cabinet on a 480 V feeder: peak shaving beside a genset, or frequency response on a small island.

quests.title: A battery on the grid
quests.text: A PCS, two containers of 96 modules and an MV skid on a distribution feeder: 2.5 MW for four hours.

quests.title: A grid from a battery
quests.text: Set a block (or a cabinet) to GRID FORMING on a dead bus: it closes with a soft start and holds the island while a genset synchronises to it.

tasks.text: Black-start a dead bus from a battery
